{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Confirm only two channels exist
channels = sales['channel'].unique()
print(f'Channels in data: {channels}')

# Filter out refunded orders (per documentation)
non_refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check revenue column type and clean it
print(f'Revenue dtype: {non_refunded['revenue'].dtype}')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
non_refunded['revenue_clean'] = non_refunded['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders
qa_filter = non_refunded['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f'QA orders found: {qa_filter.sum()}')

# Confirm no QA orders in non-refunded data
if qa_filter.sum() == 0:
    print('No QA orders in non-refunded data. Proceeding.')
else:
    print('QA orders present — will exclude them.')
    non_refunded = non_refunded[~qa_filter]

# Compute total revenue per channel
channel_revenue = non_refunded.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Output result
channel_revenue"}
